recommendation: Keep this source fix. Do not re-add 406149000 or 371900001 for FHIR-9552 unless Pharmacy explicitly reopens or supersedes FHIR-17836; handle broader medication-not-given coverage as a new terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-9552 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 by Pharmacy. It requested additional SNOMED CT reasons for MedicationAdministration reason-not-given and approved changing the example ValueSet to the union of hierarchies 406149000 Medication Refused, 371900001 Medication Not Administered, and 242990004 Non Administration of necessary drug or medicine, without renaming the ValueSet.
initial_application: Commit 055e6c67af51c6ea21726fe2c7ed0539dc1fdd4d explicitly listed 9552/9298 and changed source/medicationadministration/valueset-reason-medication-not-given-codes.xml from the old local FHIR CodeSystem include to the three approved SNOMED CT hierarchy filters and broad description.
additional_context: FHIR-9298 records the same Pharmacy vote and the same three-hierarchy ValueSet resolution. Later Published Pharmacy issue FHIR-17836 superseded the broad compose and changed MedicationAdministration.statusReason to the current 182895007 Drug declined by patient and 242990004 Drug not available for administration filters; the combined branch already contains FHIR-17836 audit commit a0986d196aceecf4d131274f95bd2bbb6342d026. MedicationAdministration is active/approved in source/fhir.ini and statusReason is bound to this ValueSet source. Zulip discussion in 2018 shows terminology concern about the broad multi-hierarchy ValueSet and is consistent with the later narrowing.
reconciliation: Changed only the ValueSet description so it no longer describes the superseded all-medication-refused/all-medication-not-administered union while the compose contains the later two SNOMED CT filters. The compose was intentionally left unchanged to avoid reversing FHIR-17836.
source_changes: source/medicationadministration/valueset-reason-medication-not-given-codes.xml: updated the description to say the ValueSet includes drug declined by patient and drug not available for administration codes from SNOMED CT, matching the current compose filters.
